risks.risk: One booster engine fails 30 s after liftoff
risks.mitigation: Engine-out capability: the other 32 engines burn longer; return reserve sized with margin
risks.unmitigated: No engine-out capability: abort, mission lost
risks.mitigated: orbit reached: True, ship residual 26.5 t; booster return margin 11.7% of reserve

risks.risk: One ship sea-level engine fails 60 s after staging
risks.mitigation: Remaining five engines burn longer; cargo ship reaches orbit with less residual and takes one more tanker
risks.mitigated: orbit reached: True, residual 28.6 t (nominal 33.1 t)

risks.risk: Tanker flights less reliable (90%) and slower to turn around (20 days)
risks.consequence: ship not full when the launch period closes: 26-month slip
risks.mitigation: Third pad, campaign starts 40 days earlier, sunshade on the waiting ship

risks.risk: Boil-off in LEO three times the estimate (0.3%/day)
risks.consequence: propellant lost faster than tankers deliver it
risks.mitigation: Sunshade and insulation on the waiting ship (0.03%/day) [est]

risks.risk: One vacuum engine fails at the start of trans-Mars injection
risks.consequence: longer burn, larger gravity loss, landing propellant eaten
risks.mitigation: Fly on two vacuum engines (or add the three sea-level engines) and spend the 2% LEO margin
risks.unmitigated: 2 RVac: 593 t burned vs 592 t nominal (gravity loss 26 m/s)
risks.mitigated: 2 RVac + 3 SL: 602 t; margin available 132 t

risks.risk: Mars atmosphere density varies 35% (1-sigma) instead of 15%, e.g. during a dust storm
risks.consequence: crash or propellant exhausted on landing
risks.mitigation: Steepen the entry to -12.4 deg with the final correction and carry 20 t more landing propellant when orbiters report thin air

risks.risk: One of three landing engines fails to light
risks.mitigation: Design change: a fourth sea-level engine (+1.9 t) so one failure leaves three
risks.unmitigated: 3 engines, one out: crashed=True, used 115 t, impact 592 m/s
risks.mitigated: 4 engines, one out: crashed=False, used 105 t of 115 t, touchdown 0.7 m/s

risks.risk: Global dust storm during the surface stay (sunlight ~30% for 60-120 sols)
risks.consequence: return propellant not ready: return slips 26 months
risks.mitigation: Fission power sized for a certain storm: 380 kWe (baseline 360 kWe) beside 40,000 m2 of arrays

risks.risk: Earth entry at ~12.3 km/s overheats the tile heat shield
risks.mitigation: Ablative windward heat shield on the return ship (+6 t) [est rating 400 W/cm2]
risks.unmitigated: peak 152 W/cm2 vs tile limit 100 W/cm2
risks.mitigated: peak 152 W/cm2 vs ablator limit 400 W/cm2
